ownership.quote: In order to vigorously pursue these ideas, we have raised 4.9 million dollars of seed capital. Our investors are Dan Scholnick from Four Rivers Ventures, Guillermo from Rauch Capital, Lee Jacobs from Long Journey Ventures, the Mozilla Corporation, Shasta Ventures, and our long-time collaborator Ben Noordhuis.

stage.quote: The Deno company has raised $21M in an investment round led by Sequoia Capital with participation from Nat Friedman, Four Rivers Ventures, Insight Partners, Long Journey Ventures, Dylan Field, Automattic, Netlify, and Shasta Ventures.
stage.note: Deno Land Inc (the commercial entity behind Deno Deploy / Deno Sandbox) raised a $4.9M seed round (announced March 29, 2021) and a $21M Series A (announced June 21, 2022, led by Sequoia Capital). No later priced round found as of 2026-09-30; last round is Series A.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of confirmed rounds per Deno's own blog posts: $4.9M seed (the-deno-company, 2021-03-29) + $21M Series A (series-a, 2022-06-21) = $25.9M.
total_funding_usd.quote: we have raised 4.9 million dollars of seed capital

last_round.quote: Deno raises $21M ... The Deno company has raised $21M in an investment round led by Sequoia Capital with participation from Nat Friedman, Four Rivers Ventures, Insight Partners, Long Journey Ventures, Dylan Field, Automattic, Netlify, and Shasta Ventures.

note: Deno Sandbox is a commercial product of Deno Land Inc (also branded 'The Deno Company'), the for-profit entity founded by Ryan Dahl (Node.js/Deno creator) to commercialize the open-source Deno runtime via Deno Deploy/Sandbox/Subhosting. Not a subsidiary of a larger company; independently venture-backed. No evidence of acquisition, IPO, or a priced round after the 2022 Series A was found.
